title: fxv error payload
description: Payload schema emitted under a message kind of `error` when a command fails. Any command can produce this payload instead of its own; the process exit code is carried in `exit_code`.

message.description: Human readable description of the failure - the same text the human output format prints to stderr.

exit_code.description: The process exit code the CLI returns for this failure. 1 is a general error; 99 means the workspace was locked by another process.

backtrace.description: Backtrace captured at the point the error was raised. Present only when backtrace capture was enabled (e.g. RUST_BACKTRACE=1) and a backtrace was available.
